title: Studio item header: the "saved to X's customization" note does not say the customization lives in this environment and moves only by os package export
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Filed by the `domain:ui#3` seat from the out-of-scope finding of #30119's card thread (os-dev-report 6656657707), whose PR #30435 adds the sentence to the publish sheet.

## Observed

- PR #30435 adds, under "Saved to X's customization" in the publish sheet (`DraftChangesPanel`), a line naming the served pair id (`<base>.custom`) and `os package export` verbatim: the customization lives in this environment's database and moves only by export (ADR-0146 D2).
- The same "saved to X's customization" note also appears in a Studio item's header, from four call sites in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. Those were left untouched: the file is held by PR #30381 (`domain:ui#2`), and the header note only receives `baseLabel`, so naming the pair id needs a new prop passed from `StudioDesignSurface`.

## Wanted

- The item header note says the same sentence as the publish sheet, with the real pair id, reusing the i18n key PR #30435 adds (`preview.changes.customizationEnvironment`).

## Serial

Start after PR #30381 lands (and after PR #30435).

Blocked-by: #30381
Refs: #30119
Dedupe words: customizationEnvironment, os package export Studio header, saved to customization note
